title: Come rendere trasparente il tuo uso dell'AI quando scrivi un contenuto
author: Fabio Chinaglia
extra_notes: Register opened before writing began. Case run in light mode until the icon was requested, then moved to full: nothing was lost, the register is the same file. The text was drafted in full by the language model on the author's instruction, from the author's own methodological document; hence 100% AI words. The register is not sealed: the Ed25519 signature must be performed by the author, whose key does not and must not live in the model's environment. Not published: no third party can inspect this at the time of writing.
